sentences.text: % 12.08.2024 CRL.M.A. 23788/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The Petitioner has approached this Court seeking Parole for a period of two months to re-establish the social ties.

2. The facts of the case reveal that vide Order dated 12.08.2014 passed by the learned Trial Court,
the Petitioner has been sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life with fine in a case arising out of FIR No.142/2011 registered at Police Station Mundka for offences under Section 302/498A IPC.
3. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner states that the Petitioner has spent more than 12 years in custody.
He states that an application for Parole has been filed, which is dated 16.04.2024, but the same has yet not been This is a digitally signed order.

4. Issue notice.
5. Learned Counsel for the State, accepts notice.
6. Let a Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
